summary:
Cantabria has no autonomous statute of its own on legal gender recognition, on discrimination on grounds of sexual orientation, sexual identity, gender expression or sexual characteristics, or on harassment. The region stands under the national framework set by Spain's Ley 4/2023 of 28 February 2023, which applies uniformly across the autonomous communities, so a trans visitor to Cantabria meets the same legal position as anywhere else in Spain rather than a Cantabrian variant of it.

The one geographic dimension the framework itself carries is a mandate for measures adapted to rural circumstances, the provision most likely to govern how the law reaches Cantabria's inland and thinly populated areas. The source inventory records no Cantabrian enforcement action, incident, prosecution, care restriction or facility dispute, so no region-specific risk picture can be drawn from it.
tangentialFactors: No regional instrument was identified that sits alongside the national framework: no Cantabrian non-discrimination law, no regional ban on conversion practices, and no autonomous procedure for legal gender recognition. The single document in the inventory is the national statute itself, and it offers no regional comparator or adjacent measure for this record to weigh.
localsOnly: Residents of Cantabria rely on the national framework for legal gender recognition and for protection against discrimination and harassment, because the region has enacted no law of its own in these areas. The inventory names no Cantabrian institution with a separate role in processing or enforcing those rights.
outOfScopeNotes:
No Cantabrian court decision, regional hate-crime count, health-service rule or facility-access dispute appears in the source inventory. Those questions are unresolved at regional level and would require Cantabrian sources to answer; the regional assessment therefore rests on the fact of uniform national application rather than on regional evidence.

Whether the rural-circumstances mandate has produced any specific measure within Cantabria is not sourced.
